summary: Defines MIB objects that allow configuring middleboxes, such as firewalls and network address translators, so communication can pass through them. The objects follow closely the MIDCOM semantics of RFC 5189. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: This is a settings sheet for firewalls and address-translating boxes, written in the shared format network tools can read and change.

questions: snmp mib for firewall and nat control
